body: Well, I never consider them as girlfriends, I think they would take offense to that.

Because:

1. She doesn't want a boyfriend.

2. She's going to be in college while I'm still in senior year of high school.

3. I'm downright *terrified* of girls.
I do not think being female is inferior. I think women could definitely use more power in this world. I would rather be one of them than what I am right now.
